source: Frozen from the 2026-09-25 dynasty research (scratchpad/dynasty: aging.json, prospects.json, league-structure.json, design_sim/scale_out.json, spec_check/proto3.cjs + sim3.cjs). Spec: scratchpad/dynasty/SPEC.md. Refit when 2026-27 is complete.

scale.source: OLS realized 2025-26 FP/G (league scoring, MoneyPuck) on the 2026-27 projection (values.json per-game FP), players with >= 40 GP in both (design_sim/scale.cjs). F x = off; D x = off + max(0, dx). Goalies: identity on gE per start (projected 4.09 vs realized 4.00). Refit 2026-09-26 after the per-segment skater rate calibration (npm run rates:recalibrate: the projections lost their ~0.85 FP/G inflation, so the 2026-09-25 map F -1.051 + 1.055x, D -1.512 + 1.252x would have taken it off twice): same fit on the recalibrated values.json (scratchpad/ratefix/scalefit.ts, realized FP/G from the league's points model on player-profiles.json; on the old values.json it reproduces the 2026-09-25 fit to F -1.073 + 1.065x, D -1.403 + 1.250x, and that gap to the MoneyPuck-based fit is carried over): raw refit F -0.149 + 1.071x (r .972), D -0.274 + 1.173x (r .957). The waiver line (265 skaters, km/repl.cjs, k = 1.27: F 2.183, D 2.282; old values 3.020 / 3.036) and the #24 forward's off (3.933; old 4.801) are recomputed the same way: realized replacement levels R_F 2.135 -> 2.186 (young forwards near the waiver line are no longer projected ~20% low), R_D 2.294 -> 2.296, offRef 4.014 -> 4.046.

repl.source: Skaters: waiver line (265 skaters, cap-adjusted 16.5 skater-equivalents per team, league-structure.json scheduleAndReplacement) mapped to the realized scale. Goalies: per season-slot, a waiver goalie gives ~35 starts x 3.65 (range 100-160); matches revealed keeper behaviour. R_Gs is on the 82-game basis and scales with seasonGames / projectionBasis (84-game season: 131.1).

year0AgeCal.source: Half-strength calibration of the ML projections' age effect: median of (2025-26 realized x one year of curve growth) / realized-scale projection, players >= 60 GP with a >= 40 GP projection; adj = clamp(1 + 0.5 (1/ratio - 1), 0.94, 1.06); cells with n < 15 set to 1 (D <=21, 22-23, 36+).

lambda.source: Scaling of the post-26 decline, c~(a) = c(26) (c(a)/c(26))^lambda: out-of-sample optimum 0.5, in-sample horizon fit 0.75 (design_sim/backtest.cjs); lambda = 0.65 moved no benchmark rank by more than 5.

sigma.source: Year-0 projection error by career GP (design choice); persistent talent shock and transient season noise from aging.json variance decomposition (F .109/.123, D .086/.102; F persistent shrunk to .09); goalies judgment. Young skaters in the growth model (base season at 18-23) use growth.sigma by production band instead of sigma0 / persistent inside the growth window.

curves.source: aging.json skaters.{F,D}.curve[].levelVs26 (conditional regressed-baseline delta method, MoneyPuck 2008-26) and goalies.svPctCurve.rows[].fpgMultiplier (save% above league, NHL API 1997-2026). Linear interpolation; geometric extrapolation past the last age.

availability.source: aging.json skaters.{F,D}.availability: P(regular next) and P(present next) by age at t; P(absent | not regular) = (1 - pPresentNext) / max(0.05, 1 - pRegularNext).

retentionLogistic.source: aging.json skaters.{F,D}.retentionLogistic: P(GP share >= 50% next season); age = age at Oct 1 of season t; levelPct = within-season percentile of era-normalized FP/GP among players with >=25% GP (1 = best)

starterLogistic.source: aging.json goalies.starterLogistic, refitted with two siblings (scratchpad/dynasty/fix2/goalie_roles.cjs, NHL API 1997-98..2025-26, 1,595 goalie-seasons with >= 15 GP prorated): P(games-started share >= 50% next season), P(>= 30%: at least a tandem) and P(present next season, any GP). gsShare is the RAW games-started share of the season, min(1, GS / season length) -- the unit the logistics were fitted in (lib.cjs gsFrac); the prototype fed share / 0.6, which kept starters at ~0.9 odds (keeper audit 2026-09-25). The three reproduce goalies.workloadTable by age band x tier within ~0.05 (e.g. starters 25-27: 0.75 / 0.91 vs 0.73 / 0.86; tandems 28-30: 0.28 / 0.62 vs 0.31 / 0.65).

phasesByAge.source: aging.json phases.<g>.byAge (expected next-season change and P(regular next)); effective age shifts by the elite and trajectory modifiers.

ladder.source: Realized-scale FP/G rank ladder (MoneyPuck 2023-26, gp >= 41) from prospects.json scales.quantileMap; levelPct = 1 - rank / N.

eliteTheta.source: Realized FP/G of about the 40th forward; elite forwards retain 0.940 a year vs 0.907 from ages 33 to 35 (aging.json), so they age one year younger from 31.

games.source: sim3.cjs role model: season-0 regular probability keeps the mean at the projected share; regulars 0.62 + 0.38 sqrt(U) (mean 0.873); partial U(0.05, 0.5); absent at 30+ = retired. Goalies (keeper audit 2026-09-25, scratchpad/dynasty/fix2/goalie_roles.cjs): next-season tier from the starter / >= tandem / present logistics on the raw start share (starterLogistic); a starter draws min(maxShare, max(0.5, 0.547 + 0.225 x last share + 0.10 z)) (starter seasons 1997-2026: mean 0.686, persistence 0.225, resid sd 0.10), a tandem U(0.30, 0.49) (mean 0.393), a backup U(0.04, 0.29) (mean 0.168), else out (retired at 32+). FP/start ~ 3.708 + 0.812 x raw share + 0.0735 x sv% pts above league (per-GP weighted OLS, 1,723 seasons) inverts theta into the sv% feature. Shares are of a season; games = seasonGames x share (84-game NHL schedule from 2026-27, public/fantrax/schedule-20262027.json), projections are shares of projectionBasis = 82 games (players.json gpCalibration fit on 82-game seasons). Durability carry (audit 2026-09-25): a player projected above the mean regular share (skaters, 0.873) keeps that factor on later regular draws (goalies: the next starter share follows the last one, persistence 0.225), mean-reverting by durabilityCarry per season, so a durable full-timer does not lose ~7% of his games at 2027-28 (judgment; the one-season projection is already regressed). Goalie shares capped at maxShare (0.85, as the daily model).

status0.source: Year-0 availability for a current Fantrax status (judgment, audit 2026-09-25): the expected share of the season still played when the sync shows NHL IR / LTIR (2), injured (30) or suspended (6). It scales season 0 only (value, FP and GP toward eligibility), never the role carried into 2027-28. Goalie depth: the tandem start share is recomputed with injured / suspended goalies kept in; only minors (4), unsigned (3) and inactive (7) goalies leave the depth chart.

prospect.source: Draft-slot fallback for players missing from prospects.json: logit P(200 NHL GP) by ln(pick) and prime FP/G by ln(pick) from prospects.json a_draftOutcomes (2005-2017 classes, AUC 0.81); goalie P(role) buckets; no-arrival odds decay by completed post-draft seasons; ETA lag by pick band.

growth.source: Conditional growth of young NHL skaters (Captains Dynasty scoring, NHL stats API 2008-09..2025-26, era-adjusted FP/G; rows from scratchpad/dynasty/youth/growth.cjs, fitted by scratchpad/dynasty/fix2/fit2.cjs). Base = a skater-season at 18-23 (Oct 1) with >= 30 GP (prorated); G_k = FP/G k seasons later / base FP/G among survivors (>= 20 GP), 2,653 base seasons. ln G_k = ln[c~(a+k)/c~(a)] (the lambda-scaled curve) x (1 + gamma h(pct)), h = max(0, (pct - 0.5)/0.5)^2 (above-median producers realize less of the curve growth) + A(pos, age band, k) pooled excess over the curve + B(pos, production band, k) regression to the mean (empirical-Bayes shrunk, n0 = sigma2/tau2 by method of moments; non-increasing in production by pool-adjacent-violators) + P(pos, ln pick, pct) pedigree x production surface (audit 2026-09-25: bilinear over 3 pedigree centres, top-10 / 11-32 / 33+ and undrafted at their mean ln pick, x 3 production centres, <p50 / p50-75 / p75+ at their mean pct, flat outside; least squares on the tent basis inside the joint fit, centred within each production centre, each cell shrunk by t2/(1+t2) with its cluster-robust SE; e.g. F p50-75: top-10 +0.083, 11-32 +0.033, late -0.084; D p50-75: top-10 +0.072, late -0.031; F p75+: 11-32 -0.058, late +0.025; the old single ln-pick slope, D -0.004, missed that pedigree matters at mid production and not among top producers) + v_k(pos, band)/2 (lognormal mean: the path shocks are mean-one; residual variance by production band). Joint alternating least squares, then A, B and gamma refitted with the shrunk surface. Age x production cells: method-of-moments variance ~0 -> not used. Linear over the age-band centres and production-band centres (flat outside). Production = percentile of the base FP/G among same-position, same-age backtest rows (pctKnots at pctQuantiles). Young shocks by production band: v_1 = sigma0^2 + season^2 and v_k - v_1 = (k-1) persistent^2 (floors 0.05); the band posterior sd widens sigma0. Checks (scripts/test-dynasty-growth.ts, fixtures scripts/fixtures/dynasty-growth-backtest.json): the mean G_k over 19 historical strata is within 2 SE of the survivors mean ratio in 92/94 stratum x season checks (all within 3 SE; a path 3% off everywhere fails); out of sample (fit on 2008-13 bases, test 2014-24) within 8.3% (F p75+ ~8% conservative at k4-5, pooled F and D within 4%). Target: survivors. End to end through this simulator the published eFP (zero-filled, retention included) matches history within ~10% for 18-20-year-olds and 21-23 top producers but runs high for 21-23-year-olds below the median (F 1.07 -> 1.54, D 1.16 -> 1.50 at k1..k5) and mildly for 21-23 p50-90 (1.05 -> 1.18): the growth path is the survivors growth applied to every path and the retention model keeps too many of them playing (F 22-23 below p50: survival 0.85 flat vs 0.86 -> 0.68). Their value is mostly near or below replacement, so DV moves little, but their eFP is overstated. Every young skater (base age = 2025-26 age < maxBaseAge) takes the same rule: base = the 2025-26 FP/G blended with the projection (w = GP / (GP + blendK), no games threshold; the projection reads as the 2025-26 level, as it does for young players with a base season: ln ratio +0.01, sd 0.10), year 0 = base x G_1; the year-0 sd blends the band sigma0 (weight w) with the projection error by career GP. minBaseGp only labels the base (season vs projection-led).

pedigree.form: bilinear over lnPickCentre (top-10 / 11-32 / 33+ and undrafted) x pctCentre (<p50 / p50-75 / p75+), flat outside; cell[prod][ped] (ln G, every k)

arrival.source: Historical first NHL seasons (career GP <= 20 before, >= 30 GP prorated) at 18-23, 2008-26 (scratchpad/dynasty/av/rows.json): ln FP/G sd F 0.30-0.32, D 0.24-0.27 by pick band (F #1-2 0.36, #3-5 0.27; D #1-10 0.23-0.25), less the season noise of a 40-60 GP season (F ~0.15, D ~0.13) -> persistent level sd F 0.26, D 0.22.

trajectory.source: aging.json phases.trajectoryModifiers: TOI up 1.068-1.093 x baseline, TOI down 0.936-0.975. Symmetric rule (audit 2026-09-25): -1 effective year when TOI/GP rose >= 90 s or FP/G beat the curve by > 12%, and FP/G did not fall; +1 when TOI/GP fell >= 90 s or FP/G trailed the curve by > 12%, and FP/G did not rise. Skaters 24+, last two seasons >= 40 GP each; never changes year 0. Not backtested in this form.

cutdown.source: Constitution 4.6/4.10: offseason cutdown one week before the league draft; the date is not published, assumed Sep 17 (window Aug 15 - Sep 24).

eligibility.source: Minors-eligible = skater < 100 NHL GP / goalie < 55 GP and age <= 24 (strict Fantrax reading: exactly 100 GP is not eligible).

K.source: Keeper-slot cost: 160th largest E[V_1] among players with P(eligible at the 2027 cutdown) < 0.5 (10 keepers x 16 teams), held constant (stationarity). Band = 128th..192nd. Reference run 41.6 (29.8-54.9). The keep index at a cutdown uses the expected level for the coming season (last level x aging drift x convergence), not the season shock drawn for it; the coming season role (regular / partial / out, starter / backup) counts as known in September. Keeper audit 2026-09-25 (D1): the keep index (a 4-season look-ahead with a games haircut, ~0.83 x V_1 at the line) is compared with a gate in its own units, the 160th largest keep index at the 2027 cutdown per simulated league (ungated pass, averaged; K.gate in dynasty.json), while K (the 160th E[V_1]) stays the cost charged per kept season: ~160 non-eligible keepers at the 2027 cutdown instead of ~143. (D2) goalies: no share floor in the keep index (goalieShareFloor 0), so a known backup is valued as a backup. Keep-index survival (audit 2026-09-25): each look-ahead season after the coming one is weighted by the odds he is still playing then (skaters: 1 - (1 - P(regular next)) x P(absent | not regular) at 30+, the retirement rule; goalies: P(present next) at 32+), so a 41-year-old no longer counts on four seasons. Team-conditional odds (keepers.ts): per path each team keeps its teamSlots (10) best keep indices > 0 among its non-eligible candidates, the rest of the live draft filled pick by pick by market rank; shown for rostered players next to the league-wide status (the value basis).

modes.source: DV = sum_t w_t delta^t E[G_t], w_0 = w0, w_1 = w1 (1 unless set), w_t = 1 after. Balanced: the league-revealed discount 0.65-0.75. Win-now (audit 2026-09-25): delta 0.35 (was 0.55, which left 55% of a flat profile after 2026-27 and ranked Celebrini ahead of MacKinnon), so the order follows 2026-27 value above waivers (top 20 within 2 places on average). Long-term / rebuild (audit 2026-09-25): delta 0.95, w0 0.2, w1 0.5 (was delta 0.88, w0 0.6, whose top 100 was nearly the balanced one: 2026-31 still carried 58% of a flat profile, Ovechkin and Crosby ranked with top-10 21-year-olds); a rebuilding team gets little from 2026-27 and 2027-28, so a player whose value ends within two seasons falls out of the long-term top 150 and the top 100 is ~1.5 years younger than balanced (scratchpad/dynasty/fix2/modes2.cjs on the exported eG).

market.source: Quantile anchoring for thin segments only: prospects by Fantrax Ros% (ADP tie-break), NHL-path goalies by ADP. NHL skaters never blended (redraft ADP biases against youth). Level-neutral (audit 2026-09-25): each segment is anchored on its own ladder (its members with a weight and a signal, ranked by the signal, mapped onto the same members' model values), so the layer reorders a segment without moving its level; fringe players (no model) are placed on the prospect ladder of their kind. Gap and market rank stay pool-wide (information). u = ln(DV + 10); |w (uK - uM)| <= ln 2.5 when w < 0.5. One posterior factor (balanced) scales eG, bands and every mode.

output.source: Unrostered players below this long-term DV are left out of dynasty.json.
